about: Every teaching letter order, and the editions that group them. A class records an edition; its order is the edition's order for the class's language. Entries are append-only: never edit or remove an order or an edition; a change is a new entry with a new id. Content files (word banks, books) name the order they were built for. Design: docs/design/2026-10-23-letter-order-versions.md

orders.source: ISIXHOSA_PEDAGOGICAL_ORDER in the Zazi app (origin/main src/constants/egraConstants.js) and the Masi app; also zz-integrated-django api/letter_constants.py.
orders.notes: Vowels first. Taught in the Zazi app since launch (unchanged since 2026-06-09). New Zazi classes move to the 2026-10-23 edition at the switch planned for the start of the 2027 school year. The live programme suggests letters two at a time from the flat order, so this step grouping (4, then 2s) is nominal.

orders.source: Programme team order with the i<->u and s<->n swaps (docs/research/2026-10-18-letter-order-swaps.md). Masi pack isixhosa-interim-letters-v1.
orders.notes: Never taught to children in the field. Kept so packs and drafts that reference it still resolve.
The 2026-10-18 order with z at step 4, t at step 5, d at step 7 and c at step 8. Never worse at any step.

orders.source: ENGLISH_PEDAGOGICAL_ORDER in the Zazi and Masi apps (src/constants/egraConstants.js). Masi pack english-interim-letters-v1.

orders.notes: The Letters and Sounds start (s a t p i n), regrouped so step 1 reads 'and'. is/his/has/as are tricky words.

orders.notes: Codex's 2026-10-22 order with r to step 5, g to step 7 and u to step 9. Words ending in b or d said p/t are tricky words.

editions.notes: What the Zazi app teaches every class created before the switch to the 2026-10-23 edition (planned for the start of the 2027 school year). The app's orders were unchanged from 2026-06-09. Jim, 2026-10-24: whatever the app had in Aug/Sept 2026 was the correct order at that time. Every class that exists before the switch has this edition.
The orders Jim adopted on 2026-10-23 (docs/research/2026-10-23-letter-orders-and-word-banks.md). Classes created after the switch get this edition.
